chore(perf): remove engine-server from perf benchmarks (#5948)

Drop the engine-server render benchmarks and the `server` build target
in perf-benchmarks-components. The hydration benchmarks now server-render
with @lwc/ssr-runtime instead of @lwc/engine-server, and
@lwc/engine-server is no longer a dependency of perf-benchmarks.
